dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave spline following the trailing edge boundary from the posterior insertion point to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape with a small pixel radius at the highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep incline of approximately 70 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Maximum vertical height is greater than the longitudinal base width (ratio approximately 1.3:1).

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smooth convex curve with a large radius across the anterior-dorsal cranial surface.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, thick pixel projection extending from the melon inflection point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Visible obtuse angle where the melon slope transitions into the rostrum.
